title: Longest Palindromic Substring
description:
A palindrome reads the same forwards and backwards. Find the length of the longest contiguous substring of a given string that is a palindrome.

Input format
Line 1: a string s of lowercase letters.

Output format
One integer: the length of the longest palindromic substring.
hints: Every palindrome has a centre. How many possible centres does a string of length n have?
Expand outwards from each centre while the characters on both sides match, and remember the longest result.
There are 2n-1 centres: n single characters (odd length) and n-1 gaps between characters (even length). Handling only odd centres misses palindromes such as "abba".

examples.explanation: The longest palindrome is "bb", which has an even length.
